recognize_zh: 中倍血液抹片的單一視野內就有三到四顆帶橘紅色顆粒的分葉核嗜酸性球，另有一顆核形稍不規則的小淋巴球，紅血球正常；顯示明顯嗜酸性球增多但形態成熟，是淋巴球型 HES 抹片常見的樣貌。
features: Increased eosinophils: several mature eosinophils with bilobed/segmented nuclei and orange-red granules in one field
One granulocyte in the center shows paler, lilac granules and a lobulated nucleus (neutrophil versus less granulated eosinophil)
Small lymphocyte with scant pale-blue cytoplasm and a slightly irregular nuclear outline
Red cells normocytic and normochromic; platelets present
No blasts or immature myeloid cells seen
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at intermediate power shows a relative increase in eosinophils, with several mature forms in a single field containing bilobed nuclei and abundant orange-red granules. A small lymphocyte with a slightly irregular nuclear contour is also present, and red cells and platelets appear unremarkable. No blasts or dysplastic features are evident. The findings reflect mature eosinophilia; in the setting of an aberrant CD3-CD4+CD7- T-cell population, they are consistent with the lymphocytic variant of hypereosinophilic syndrome.

ddx.dx: Reactive eosinophilia (parasitic infection, allergy, drug reaction)
ddx.vs: Morphology is indistinguishable, so the discriminator is the absence of a clonal or immunophenotypically aberrant T-cell population and a supporting clinical history.
Morphology overlaps; it is distinguished by FIP1L1-PDGFRA fusion/CHIC2 deletion and often elevated serum tryptase with atypical marrow mast cells.
CML shows marked leukocytosis with a left shift and basophilia rather than an isolated increase in mature eosinophils, and is BCR-ABL1 positive.
